hero.title: About Cerotd
hero.subtitle: Modern comprehensive manufacturer of lubricating oils and greases

intro.title: Integrated R&D, production, sales, and service
intro.desc: Cerotd (Shandong) Lubrication Technology Co., Ltd. is a modern, comprehensive manufacturer of lubricating oils and greases, integrating R&D, production, sales, service, technical training, and logistics distribution, with considerable industry scale and influence in the domestic market. Located in Jining, Shandong, and rooted in the New Material Industrial Park, the factory is equipped with advanced fully automatic blending production lines and a strict quality management system. We have long focused on automotive lubricant R&D and innovation, delivering high-tech, specialized, and comprehensive lubricant production solutions for diverse equipment needs.

item1.name: Systemized Quality
item1.desc: ISO quality, environmental, and occupational health & safety systems supporting stable delivery.

item2.name: Materials & Formulas
item2.desc: Base oils, additives, and technical formulas introduced from Fortune Global 500 enterprise resources.

item3.name: Continuous R&D
item3.desc: Cooperation with global partners and research institutes to keep upgrading products and technology.

item1.text: Factory covers more than 85 mu (approx. 56,667㎡), with about 10,000㎡ of standardized workshops and up to 15,000 m³ oil storage.

item2.text: Annual production capacity exceeds 100,000 tons across industrial, automotive, special, construction machinery, and auto-care products.

item3.text: A complete range of testing equipment helps ensure product stability and batch consistency.
